entities.name: Service-level authentication and authorization procedure
entities.description: Procedure to authenticate and/or authorize UE upper layers using NEF services, performed during or after PDU session establishment for non-emergency sessions. Supports initial authentication/authorization and re-authentication.

entities.name: SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent from SMF to UE containing service-level-AA payload, starts timer T3594.

entities.name: SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent from UE to SMF containing service-level-AA payload, stops timer T3594.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT
entities.description: Message carrying successful service-level-AA response during UE-requested PDU session establishment.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT
entities.description: Message carrying unsuccessful service-level-AA response during UE-requested PDU session establishment.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message carrying successful service-level-AA response during network-requested PDU session modification for re-authentication.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND
entities.description: Message carrying unsuccessful service-level-AA response during network-requested PDU session release for re-authentication.

entities.name: Service-level-AA payload
entities.description: Payload exchanged between UE and SMF for service-level authentication and authorization.

entities.name: Service-level-AA response
entities.description: Response indicating success or failure of service-level authentication and authorization procedure.

entities.name: T3594
entities.description: Timer started when SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND is sent, stopped when SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE is received.

entities.name: Non-emergency PDU session
entities.description: Condition that service-level AA procedure can only be performed for non-emergency PDU sessions.

entities.name: UE passes service-level-AA response to upper layer
entities.description: Behavior where UE passes received service-level-AA response to upper layers when received in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT or REJECT messages.

relations.description: Service-level AA procedure involves sending SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND messages.
Service-level AA procedure involves receiving SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE messages.
SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND contains service-level-AA payload.
SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE contains service-level-AA payload.
Sending SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND starts timer T3594.
Receiving SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE stops timer T3594.
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT contains service-level-AA response for successful authentication.
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT contains service-level-AA response for unsuccessful authentication.
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND contains service-level-AA response for successful re-authentication.
PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND contains service-level-AA response for unsuccessful re-authentication.
Service-level AA procedure requires non-emergency PDU session condition.
Receiving service-level-AA response in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT establishes UE behavior to pass response to upper layer.
Receiving service-level-AA response in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT establishes UE behavior to pass response to upper layer.
